caption: The video captures an overhead view of a single dark, diamond-shaped ray with pale spots gliding just beneath the surface of clear, bright turquoise-green water. Its broad pectoral fins rhythmically undulate, alternating between spread-wide and more folded positions as it swims. A long, thin, whip-like tail trails behind the body, swaying and shifting in apparent curvature with each undulation. Over the visible span the ray drifts gradually from the upper-middle of the frame toward the lower-middle, maintaining a roughly head-up, tail-down orientation. The surrounding water surface is covered with constantly shifting sun glitter and caustic ripples that move independently of the animal. The ray's apparent size stays roughly constant, and its motion continues steadily throughout the visible portion.
